what-is-kazi.question: What is Kazi?
what-is-kazi.answer: Kazi is a platform that connects African talents with opportunities that match their skills.

who-is-it-for.question: Who is Kazi for?
who-is-it-for.answer: Kazi is for talents who want to showcase their work, and for companies looking for profiles that match their needs.

create-profile.question: How do I create my profile?
create-profile.answer: Registration and profile creation will be available in an upcoming version. Kazi is currently in a presentation phase.

pricing.question: Is Kazi free for talents?
pricing.answer: Access to Kazi will be free for talents. Details for companies will be announced at launch.

availability.question: When will the platform be available?
availability.answer: Kazi is under construction. A first version will be unveiled soon.
